messages:
Maya: Heads-up — analyst from ByteView asked for a briefing next Wed (EMEA-friendly). Wants embargoed access to the benchmark writeup and a quote. Can we confirm timeline and who signs off on the quote?
Tom: I can run the briefing. What embargo window do we want? Most analysts expect 24–48h.
Nina: Ideally 48h for fact-checks given the benchmark numbers. Also want to avoid giving raw p95s in a quote — we should point to the public benchmark doc and give a high-level summary.
Maya: Agreed on 48h. We need a text quote cleared by a comms + product owner 24h before embargo lifts.
Eli: I can do quick eyes on the quote but prefer product to draft. Who drafts?
Nina: I will draft the initial quote and include a short line about production economics: "we focus on predictable latency and unit economics for LLM inference." Kept generic.
Kate: Logistics: ByteView wants EU-friendly time. Proposed slots: Tue 09:00 GMT or Wed 10:00 CET (their preference). Tom, confirm availability?
Tom: Wed 10:00 CET works for me. I'll add a calendar invite and include a Zoom link.
Maya: Press embargo text (draft):
```
Embargo: Please do not publish any coverage based on this briefing before 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC.
Fact-check window: 48 hours after receipt of fact-checks.
Quote sign-off: Final quote due 24 hours before embargo lift.
```
Maya: Can someone confirm the embargo timestamp above fits product/legal?
Nina: 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC is fine. Legal ok with 48h fact-check window.
Tom: I'll send the embargo note in the outreach email.
PressBot: Reminder: press list ingestion complete — ByteView contact: amanda@byteview.media
Maya: Quick Q from the analyst: "Can we get a ballpark on token cost and p50 latency for the hosted API in EU region?"
Nina: Do not give exact per-customer costs. Provide ranges and reference benchmarks. Suggest: "typical single-query p50 latency is in the low-100s ms on our hosted tier; unit economics vary by model and config — see our benchmarks: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks"
Eli: +1. If they press for dollars, offer a follow-up cal with Solutions to discuss real pricing.
Tom: Draft outreach blurb I plan to send: "Thanks Amanda — happy to brief Wed 10:00 CET. We can share an embargoed benchmark summary and a short, cleared quote. Please confirm preferred fact-check contact and any deadlines." Thoughts?
Maya: Blurb looks good. Add: "If you need specific latency numbers for a workload, we can do a follow-up technical call."
Tom: Got it — will send within the hour. :thumbsup:
Maya: Action items — Nina drafts quote (due 1799865600), Tom sends outreach and invite, Kate confirms calendar domain and timezone attendees, Eli available for final sign-off.
Nina: Will drop the draft into the thread when ready.
Maya: Thanks all — tagging for visibility. :sparkles:
